## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/gemini/videos/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['create a Gemini Veo video generation request by transforming OpenAI-style parameters into the Veo API format', 'create a VideoObject from a Gemini Veo long-running operation response with status and usage data', 'run a video status retrieve request to poll a Gemini Veo operation by its operation name', 'run a video content request to download a completed Gemini Veo generated video by its video ID', 'build a mapping from OpenAI video creation parameters to Gemini Veo API parameters including aspect ratio and resolution']
```

Usage

```
{'create_transform_video_create_request': 'create a Gemini Veo video generation request by transforming OpenAI-style parameters into the Veo API format', 'create_transform_video_create_response': 'create a VideoObject from a Gemini Veo long-running operation response with status and usage data', 'run_transform_video_status_retrieve_request': 'run a video status retrieve request to poll a Gemini Veo operation by its operation name', 'run_transform_video_content_request': 'run a video content request to download a completed Gemini Veo generated video by its video ID', 'build_map_openai_params': 'build a mapping from OpenAI video creation parameters to Gemini Veo API parameters including aspect ratio and resolution'}
```
